title: ComplianceCheck
description: One compliance check: its findings, or its progress toward them.

id.title: Id
id.description: Public identifier, `cck_` followed by 32 hex characters.

matterId.title: Matterid
matterId.description: `mat_` identifier of the matter this check belongs to.

status.description: Check status, using the same five public values as an operation. While `queued` or `running`, `requirements` is empty and the scalar fields are absent. That is the truthful shape of a check that has not happened yet, not an error.

regulationType.title: Regulationtype
regulationType.description: Regulation checked against, echoed from the request.

documentCategory.title: Documentcategory
documentCategory.description: Document category, echoed from the request.

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.description: Every requirement checked, and the verdict on each.

notApplicableCount.title: Notapplicablecount
notApplicableCount.description: Requirements that do not apply to this document.

remediationActions.title: Remediationactions
remediationActions.description: What to do about them, in priority order.

responseTimeline.title: Responsetimeline
responseTimeline.description: A regulatory deadline that applies, where one does.

deterministicCoverage.title: Deterministiccoverage
deterministicCoverage.description: Fraction of requirements with keyword evidence in the document, 0 to 1. Low coverage means more of the verdict rests on the model than on the text.

preCheckFlags.title: Precheckflags
preCheckFlags.description: Where the model and a deterministic keyword scan disagreed. Each one is worth a human glance.

parseWarning.title: Parsewarning
parseWarning.description: Set when the model's output only partly parsed, which means the findings may be incomplete.

completedAt.title: Completedat
completedAt.description: When the check reached a terminal status (RFC 3339).

description.title: Description
description.description: What is missing, and why it matters.

regulationReference.title: Regulationreference
regulationReference.description: The provision the gap is measured against.

riskLevel.title: Risklevel
riskLevel.description: How risky the gap is: `critical`, `high`, `medium` or `low`.

remediation.title: Remediation
remediation.description: Suggested language or action to close it.

ComplianceGap.title: ComplianceGap
ComplianceGap.description: One compliance gap, named so it can be tracked.

ComplianceRemediationAction.title: ComplianceRemediationAction
ComplianceRemediationAction.description: One thing to do, in priority order.

regulationReference.title: Regulationreference
regulationReference.description: Where it comes from, for example `GDPR Article 28(3)(a)`.

status.title: Status
status.description: Whether the document meets it: `compliant`, `partially_compliant`, `non_compliant`, or `not_applicable`.

gapDescription.title: Gapdescription
gapDescription.description: What is missing, where the document does not meet it.

recommendation.title: Recommendation
recommendation.description: What to change to meet it.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: How urgent the remediation is: `critical`, `high`, `medium` or `low`.

ComplianceRequirement.title: ComplianceRequirement
ComplianceRequirement.description: One requirement of the regulation, and whether the document meets it.

OperationStatus.title: OperationStatus
OperationStatus.description:
The public five. There is no sixth, and there are no synonyms.

Internal vocabularies spell terminal success `completed`, `ready`,
`extracted`, `succeeded` and `fresh`; terminal failure `failed` and `error`;
queued `pending`, `queued` and `draft`. All of that is collapsed here by
`app.workspace_api.adapters.status_map`, which refuses to guess.
